subject: POC kickoff & hands-on session — multi-timezone scheduling
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@acme-enterprises.com>, Kenji Tanaka <kenji.tanaka@novatech.jp>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finco.eu>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & hands-on session — multi-timezone scheduling

Hi all,

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood for this POC. We'd like to schedule a 90-minute POC kickoff + hands-on working session where we'll:
- Walk through the POC goals and mutual action plan
- Do a prompt review and routing configuration walk-through
- Run a short load test (non-prod) and review results live

To make this work across your teams in US/EU/APAC, can you confirm availability for the week of March 22? Suggested slots that try to be fair across timezones:
- Option A: 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC (US morning / EU afternoon)
- Option B: 2026-03-24 12:00 UTC (EU morning / APAC evening)
- Option C: 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC (APAC morning / US late evening)

We can also run repeating rotating windows for follow-up deep dives if you'd prefer a standing weekly time that rotates. I've attached a draft agenda (POC_Agenda_v1.pdf) and a living POC plan in Drive (link below).

Please reply with preferred option(s) and attendee list.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf

From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@acme-enterprises.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 13:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on session — multi-timezone scheduling

Thanks Jordan — this looks great.

We can do Option A (2026-03-23 16:00 UTC) or Option B (2026-03-24 12:00 UTC). Our engineering team prefers rotating sessions so that no one is always taking late-night calls; weekly rotation would be ideal.

Attendees from Acme: myself (Product), Miguel Torres (Backend), Priya Iyer (SRE - will own load test coordination).

If you have a suggested rotation cadence (weekly / biweekly) please propose and we'll confirm.

Best,
Anna
Product Lead — Acme Enterprises

Hi Jordan / Anna,

Thanks — we can make Option B (2026-03-24 12:00 UTC) work from Tokyo side if the meeting stays under 2 hours. Option C at 02:00 UTC is feasible for one-off but not ideal on a recurring basis.

A couple of logistics items from our end:
- For load tests we will need a short maintenance window and sanitized test data. Can Redwood confirm the test dataset access approach?
- We'll send two engineers for the hands-on session (integration + inference ops).

Soojin — can you confirm who from Redwood will own the routing config walkthrough and prompt review?

Regards,
Kenji

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on session — multi-timezone scheduling

Appreciate the quick replies — sounds like Option B (2026-03-24 12:00 UTC) is the best single fit. Given the preference for rotating sessions, here's a proposed cadence we can operate under:

- Week 1: US-friendly window (Option A)
- Week 2: EU-friendly window (Option B)
- Week 3: APAC-friendly window (Option C - one-off timing adjustments allowed)

That would rotate the inconvenience and keep folks aligned.

Action items from our side:
- I'll own the prompt review and live routing demo (Soojin will provide the deep-dive on kernel/quantization behavior).
- Rishi will lead the short load test and collect metrics (latency, p99, token cost).
- Laura will distribute the final agenda and calendar invites once we confirm the slot.

I've created a shared POC plan and a Doodle poll for final slot selection: https://doodle.com/poll/pocevent and added a working spreadsheet (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPOCPlan). Attaching the POC plan workbook (poc-plan.xlsx).

Can everyone confirm that rotation cadence and final slot (we're leaning to 2026-03-24 12:00 UTC)?

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: poc-plan.xlsx
